items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free-style cleanser that cleans without stripping skin that scans as dry.
A gentle brightening cream that helps the look of uneven tone on the cheeks without harsh exfoliation.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to support the low moisture score and keep skin comfortable.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides to help protect the look of uneven tone from sun and visible light.

response.routine_note: I've left out the 30% peel and the 1% retinol because strong exfoliation and high-strength actives can irritate deeper skin tones and make dark patches look worse, so start with this gentler set: cleanser, azelaic cream and moisturizer morning and night, with SPF every morning. If the patches persist or change, a dermatologist can look at your skin in person and advise on stronger options.
